scope: Preparation audit only; no executable model, fit, rescore, owner-process control, publication, or source admission

recommendation.reason: A single pooled national gas-change term has complete 2002–2024 dated TWIP rows and the aggregate F-only runner is reusable after a versioned matched-support preparation. Nothing fundamental blocks a retrospective development pilot; the adapter, tests and execution plan are not yet written. This assigned audit does not launch a fit.

design.primary_comparison: matched F0 versus G01=F0+one national gasoline term; H0 on the same support is an optional descriptive third arm
design.target: ordinary U.S. Senate Democratic share D/(D+R), aggregate fundamentals-only
design.raw_feature: ln(national regular retail USD/gallon at printed current Monday observation / printed observation exactly 91 days earlier)
design.orientation: p_t=president_party_asof, +1 Democratic/-1 Republican; u_t=p_t*raw_feature; x_t=(u_t-mean earlier unique cycles)/population SD earlier unique cycles, one equal weight per cycle
design.coefficient: one sign-unrestricted G01 mean coefficient beta~Normal(0,0.05) on D-share logit per training-standardized unit; outcome-blind proposed prior, not inherited qualification
design.nested_density: At beta=0, G01 likelihood and all F0 parameters/priors equal matched-support F0, multiplied by the proper beta prior density; verify in code/tests
design.not_in_primary: No E01 incumbent substitution, state exposure interaction, midterm-specific gas slope, extra national shock, posterior column splice or polling contribution

source_and_cutoff.existing_panel_cutoff_convention: 23:59:59 UTC at H14; new join must bind existing Senate exact 00:00 UTC H14 and recheck both source upper bounds
source_and_cutoff.qualification: Official dated archived TWIP issues support retrospective pre-cutoff proxy; original posting/no-revision logs not authenticated, so no strict original-publication claim
source_and_cutoff.2004: Exact reviewed stale-header-year exception is required; raw report/header conflict remains visible
source_and_cutoff.method_change: 2018-05-14 gasoline sampling break; no selected within-year 91-day pair crosses it
source_and_cutoff.2026: No current-2026 gas row in this panel; later prospective use needs its own cutoff-bound source

matched_training.interpretation: National gas feature has 8/9/10/11 earlier cycle realizations, not 236/266/294/324 independent macro observations. Refit F0 and G01 on identical 2002+ rows; old 1998+ F0 scores/banks/masks are not a matched comparator.

prior_geometry.consequence: Raw-first standardization with an independent beta SD changes the implied office/party offsets and raw-gas slope prior even where mean functions span the same terms. Freeze orient-first transformation and check prior predictive behavior/parameter overlap with F0 party/carryover terms.

reuse_boundaries.reuse: Owner aggregate component factory H0/F0 laws, label-free ordinary-Senate panel and outcomes, chronological folds, joint four-chain fit/predictive/score/MCSE routines, numerical gates, fixed F0-mask convention, runtime package environment if newly pinned/reviewed
reuse_boundaries.versioned_changes: New TWIP source verifier/label-free feature join, exact-midnight H14 check, 2002 start-cycle/admission and outcome filter, G01 provider with one owned mean term, support-matched H0/F0/G01 preparation, arm/job-count/seed/source snapshots and run-plan validation; fresh full joint posterior fits and prediction seals; no reuse of E01 posterior, previous F0 score, old F0 mask or prior sensitivity as scored selection
reuse_boundaries.before_launch: Pin source bytes and new plan/runtime code; test historical-support exclusion, source date/units/91-day arithmetic, nested beta-zero density, equal-cycle scaler, prior predictive range, label sealing, plan/runtime checks and failure preservation; independently review these. Launch of a versioned retrospective development experiment is a separate root task, not an approval gate inferred from this audit.

benchmarks.E01_result: Both 2018 and 2022 headline-CPI arms lost to F0; this rejects that specification, not every gas time-horizon hypothesis
benchmarks.status: All A2018/2022 and B2020/2024 target years were exposed as development benchmarks. Earlier target outcomes can train later folds, so no globally unopened holdout or prospective qualification claim.
benchmarks.score_policy: F0-to-G01 share CRPS primary on matched folds; report per-cycle and equal-cycle A/B deltas, winner/interval/competitive diagnostics and numerical MCSE. No race-iid inference from common national gas.

runtime.expected_G01_12_job_planning_order: roughly 10–25 minutes if same runtime/hardware and comparable convergence; not a bound or reason to relax gates
runtime.runtime_caveat: Existing runtime acceptance pins old code/plan; a new plan/source review must bind unchanged packages plus new adapter/runner before execution.

luna_exchange.initial_difference: Luna initially viewed a state gasoline-exposure interaction as necessary for scientific distinction and proposed E01 versus E01+gas. Sol argued national 13-week gas change is a distinct time-scale/salience measure from CPI YoY, with selected F0 as the relevant incumbent.
luna_exchange.resolved: Luna agreed primary pooled national G01 versus matched F0, deferred exposure interaction and optional CPI complementarity. Both agree only development-benchmark interpretation and thin cycle-level support.
luna_exchange.remaining_disagreement: none on preparation feasibility or primary pair
